payload.body:
**Ticket ID:** `MP-ART-ANALYSIS-001`  
**Priority:** P0  

---


# Wire analysis resource with manifest, agent-data-api GET and POST handlers, SDK, tests, and dev-docs

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

The analysis Zod schemas exist under `packages/shared/agent-data-api-contract/src/analysis.ts`, but the resource is not registered in `agentDataApiManifest`, has no HTTP handlers in `apps/mediapulse/agent-data-api`, and has no typed SDK methods. This ticket delivers the full stack slice so agents can call GET and POST analysis through the existing token-auth pattern and Prisma-backed service layer.

## Scope

- In scope: Add `analysis` (or agreed camelCase key) to `agentDataApiManifest` with v1 and v2 entries using existing GET query, GET response, POST body, and POST response schemas. Implement route registration consistent with [register-agent-data-api-routes.ts](apps/mediapulse/agent-data-api/src/register-agent-data-api-routes.ts). Implement GET handler that returns `dataSources`, `entityTypes`, `relationTypes`, and `existingEntities` per ticker and `unanalyzed` flag. Implement POST handler that persists entities, relations, `articleEntities`, and `articleRelevances` per contract and returns `entitiesCreated`, `entitiesReused`, `relationsCreated`, `articlesScored`, and `articlesSelected`. Wire `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` methods. Add Vitest coverage for handlers or services. Update [dev-docs agent-data-api](dev-docs/docs/mediapulse/apps/agent-data-api.mdx) per agent-data-api-endpoints workflow. Database access only inside agent-data-api (FR8, no direct DB from agent process).
- Out of scope: Article-analysis agent runtime, LLM extraction, chunked POST logic in the agent, optional GET `timeWindow` (covered in MP-ART-ANALYSIS-002). Hermes env keys for tuning (MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `agentDataApiManifest` includes analysis resource with GET and POST schemas from `@workspace/agent-data-api-contract`.
- [x] Agent-data-api exposes GET and POST for analysis with paths derived from manifest conventions and validates inputs and outputs with shared Zod schemas.
- [x] GET returns empty `dataSources` when none are eligible without error, matching PRD empty-GET behavior.
- [x] POST rejects bodies that fail `postAnalysisBodySchema` with structured errors and does not persist invalid slices.
- [x] Typed SDK client supports analysis GET and POST with response validation.
- [x] Tests cover success and primary failure paths for the new handlers or services.
- [x] Dev-docs for agent-data-api describe the analysis endpoints.
- [x] `pnpm code-quality` passes for touched packages.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-002, MP-ART-ANALYSIS-003, and all downstream agent tickets

## Notes

Follow [.cursor/skills/agent-data-api-endpoints/SKILL.md](.cursor/skills/agent-data-api-endpoints/SKILL.md) and [.cursor/rules/agent-data-api-endpoints.mdc](.cursor/rules/agent-data-api-endpoints.mdc). Use Prisma strong typing patterns for queries. Map contract fields to existing models (`DataSource`, `Entity`, `EntityRelation`, `ArticleEntity`, `ArticleRelevance`, `EntityType`, `RelationType`, etc.) as already implied by the PRD and database section.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/article-analysis-agent-prd.md
